snippet.title: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature, the game that plays as a warm hug. Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1989720/Unpetrified_Echoes_of_Nature/
